faq.question: Is SNAPPY a real HostGator promo code?
faq.answer: Yes. HostGator publishes SNAPPY on its official coupons page, with a Baby-plan, 36-month footnote. This is source verification, not a completed checkout test.

faq.question: How do I use the code?
faq.answer: Open the official coupons page and follow Redeem. If checkout has another code, replace it with your chosen code and select Validate. Review the recalculated total and eligibility before paying.

faq.question: Can I use SNAPPY for VPS or a renewal?
faq.answer: We have not verified VPS eligibility. The official coupon rules exclude renewals and existing services; use the separate VPS page to inspect its published pricing.

faq.question: Is a monthly plan covered by the refund guarantee?
faq.answer: No. Section 13 excludes services with a monthly term, as well as the other fees listed in its refund conditions.
